code: # twelve towns over ten years; four adopt a by-law in 2019, four in 2021 d <- expand.grid(year = 2015:2024, town = LETTERS[1:12]) i <- match(d$town, LETTERS) first <- c(2019, 2019, 2019, 2019, 2021, 2021, 2021, 2021, NA, NA, NA, NA) d$bylaw <- as.integer(!is.na(first[i]) & d$year >= first[i]) d$rate <- 30 + i + 0.5 * (d$year - 2015) - 4 * d$bylaw + sin(seq_len(120)) r <- didfe(d$rate, d$town, d$year, d$bylaw) r #> didfe: ols, 120 rows, 12 units, 10 periods, 12 clusters #>  term       est        se       lo        hi      stat            p #>   trt -4.179346 0.2529069 -4.73599 -3.622702 -16.52524 4.095738e-09 #> comparison mean 41.26246, relative effect -0.1012869 # its comparisons, and each adopting town left out in turn didfe(d$rate, d$town, d$year, d$bylaw, bacon = TRUE, loo = TRUE)$bacon #>               type treated control       est weight #> 1 treated vs never    2019     Inf -4.081194  0.375 #> 2 treated vs never    2021     Inf -4.029237  0.375 #> 3 earlier vs later    2019    2021 -4.561454  0.125 #> 4 later vs earlier    2021    2019 -4.542020  0.125 # the simulated panel of polex(): a reform with a known effect of -3 p <- polex() didfe(p$crmrate, p$district, p$month, p$reformed) #> didfe: ols, 720 rows, 20 units, 36 periods, 20 clusters #>  term      est        se        lo        hi      stat           p #>   trt -3.23164 0.1164121 -3.475293 -2.987986 -27.76034 7.66007e-17 #> comparison mean 26.52167, relative effect -0.121849

title: Atmospheric dispersion: sigmas, plume rise, plume, puff, grid and particles — pgsig
text: pgsig(): Briggs (1973) fits Pasquill-Gifford dispersion coefficients stability class -F, rural sigmay = a_y x (1 + 0.0001 x)^(-1/2) (urban: 0.0004) sigmaz = a_z x (1 + b_z x)^(e_z). briggs(): buoyancy flux F = g v_s d^2 (T_s - T_a) / (4 T_s); final rise 21.425 F^(3/4) / u x_f = 49 F^(5/8) F < 55, else 38.71 F^(3/5) / u x_f = 119 F^(2/5), classes -D; 2.6 (F / (u s))^(1/3) s = g (dtheta/dz) / T_a x_f = 2.0715 u / sqrt(s) E F; transitional rise 1.6 F^(1/3) x^(2/3) / u x_f (EPA ISC3). gplume(): Q / (2 pi u sigmay sigmaz) exp(-y^2 / (2 sigmay^2)) V, V vertical term ground reflection , mixing lid, nimg pairs image terms. gspuff(): instantaneous release sigma_x = sigmay evaluated travel distance u t. advdif2d(): explicit upwind advection, central diffusion, forward Euler, zero boundaries. explicit scheme stable |u dt/dx| + |v dt/dy| + 2 (kx dt/dx^2 + ky dt/dy^2) <= 1 (von Neumann bound upwind advection forward-time centred-space diffusion); sum returned stabn stable. call outside bound run given: step split enough sub-steps smaller dt satisfy (reported substeps dt), warning, field solution physical time rather numerical explosion. separate cfl difn reported reference; 1 necessary, sufficient. lagrprt(): random walk x + u dt + sqrt(2 K dt) xi (Thomson 1987) optional counting grid. standard normals xi step k (0) come splitmix64 uniform stream (Steele, Lea Flood 2014) seeded (seed * 65536 + s) mod 2147483647, s = 2k x 2k + 1 y, normal quantile; R's random number stream touched. stability classes run "" (unstable, sunny light wind) "D" (neutral, overcast windy) "F" (stable, clear night light wind). Units SI: metres, seconds, kelvin; q g/s, gplume() returns g/m^3, mass g, gspuff() returns g/m^3. plume defined upwind source: receptor \(x \le 0\) gets 0. plume's h effective height, stack height plus rise briggs(). Every physical input checked: emission rates, masses, heights distances non-negative, wind speed, travel time grid steps positive, nimg whole number 1,000, stack hot air hotter (temperatures 150 refused probably Celsius), x0, y0 single numbers; release mixh warns, receptor ground lid (reflection terms give mirror values ). Unknown stability classes settings errors. grid models refuse run maxwork cell particle updates.

code: # plume widths 1 km downwind: neutral, then very stable, urban pgsig(1000, "D") #> $sigmay #> [1] 76.27701 #>  #> $sigmaz #> [1] 37.94733 #>  pgsig(c(500, 1000, 2000), "F", set = "urban") #> $sigmay #> [1]  50.20790  92.96697 163.97832 #>  #> $sigmaz #> [1] 30.23716 50.59644 80.00000 #>   # rise of a hot plume, and the effective height it gives a 50 m stack rise <- briggs(c(100, 1000), u = 4, diam = 1, exitvel = 12,                stktmp = 420, ambtmp = 285) rise$rise #> [1] 18.22335 28.88281 heff <- 50 + rise$finalrise  # ground-level concentration (g/m^3) from 100 g/s along the centreline rec <- cbind(x = c(500, 1000, 2000, 8000), y = 0, z = 0) gplume(100, u = 4, h = heff, rcpt = rec) #> [1] 2.120279e-05 3.168716e-04 3.826280e-04 1.051326e-04  # under a 120 m mixing lid the far receptor sees a trapped plume gplume(100, u = 4, h = heff, rcpt = rec, mixh = 120) #> [1] 2.120279e-05 3.172063e-04 4.073068e-04 1.738501e-04  # a 1 kg puff, 10 minutes after release, at the puff centre gspuff(1000, u = 3, h = 10, rcpt = rbind(c(1800, 0, 0)), t = 600) #> [1] 0.0001266794  # a small grid: a blob moved by wind and spread by diffusion c0 <- matrix(0, 15, 15) c0[4, 8] <- 1 f <- advdif2d(c0, u = 1, v = 0, kx = 0.5, ky = 0.5,               dx = 1, dy = 1, dt = 0.2, nsteps = 20) f$stable #> [1] TRUE round(f$mass, 3) #> [1] 0.962  # 2,000 simulated particles, counted on a grid p <- lagrprt(2000, x0 = 0, y0 = 0, u = 1, v = 0, kx = 1, ky = 1,              dt = 1, nsteps = 10, seed = 1,              grid = c(-10, 30, -20, 20, 8, 8)) c(p$mean_x, p$meany) #> [1] 10.033977334 -0.003237509  # inputs that cannot be right are refused try(pgsig(100, "G")) #> Error : pgsig: `stab` must be one of the Pasquill classes "A" to "F". try(briggs(100, u = 4, diam = 1, exitvel = 12, stktmp = 155, ambtmp = 20)) #> Error : briggs: temperatures are in kelvin: stktmp 155 and ambtmp 20 look like degrees Celsius (ambient air is about 290 K).

code: d <- expand.grid(year = 2015:2024, town = LETTERS[1:12]) i <- match(d$town, LETTERS) first <- rep(c(2019, 2021, NA), each = 4) d$first <- first[i] d$bylaw <- as.integer(!is.na(d$first) & d$year >= d$first) d$rate <- 30 + i + 0.5 * (d$year - 2015) - 4 * d$bylaw + sin(seq_len(120)) plot(evtst(d$rate, d$town, d$year, d$first, leads = 3, lags = 3))  plot(didfe(d$rate, d$town, d$year, d$bylaw, bacon = TRUE, loo = TRUE))  one <- d[d$town %in% c("A", "I", "J", "K", "L"), ] plot(synthc(one$rate, one$town, one$year, one$first))  plot(grprr(c(a = 120, b = 95, c = 30), c(a = 6e4, b = 2.1e4, c = 1.5e4)))  plot(kmrec(c(3, 8, 8, 12, 20, 24), event = c(1, 1, 0, 1, 0, 1),            grp = c("a", "a", "a", "b", "b", "b")))  plot(trnmat(c("N", "N", "E", "N", "W", "W", "E", "E"),             c(1, 1, 1, 2, 2, 2, 3, 3), time = c(1, 2, 3, 1, 2, 3, 1, 2)))  set.seed(1) plot(cconc(rpois(200, 2), nsim = 0))

Mann-Kendall's rank test Theil-Sen slope (median pairwise slopes, Sen's distribution-free interval) make distributional assumption; p-value exact every ordering observed values 8 periods (ties kept) normal tie continuity corrections beyond.
